items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Ignacio Pineiro saw me playing the maracas, so I went - he told me "I want you to go to the Havana Sport, that was the academy, Havana Sport. So I went out there, played maracas hor him and I played about six months.

ctx.x: Yes. Guaguanco, 'El Guaguanco Es Lo Mas Sublime que Cubita Creo,' that was written by Ignacio Pineiro, that now if he was alive he was about 105 years old, and Cotinzen, from another neighborhood, and Malanga - he was a good rumbero and a good composer - Roncona, he was a good composer too, and there was a numerous composers.
So all the popular Cuban rhythms today, what they call Salsa today, were taken from this cult music in Cuba I see.
